apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4 Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Fixes Color/HDR preference saving: selecting eight-bit disables HDR and saves both choices immediately. The picker shows effective request color. HDR off preserves separately chosen chroma/depth; ten-bit SDR and 4:4:4 SDR remain available. Color changes apply to a fresh host session; resume keeps the existing format. All Metal 4 rendering/effects and desktop native touch retained. 209 tests passed, zero failures, one hardware skip; unchanged rendering retains build-143 GPU validation. Unsigned experimental build.
